title: Community Parking Permit Rates for Community Rules & Site Care
content:
The rate of each vehicle permit on a Community Rules & Site Care plan record follows the community named on the Home-Site Lease of the site.

| Community named on the Home-Site Lease | Permit rate, per permit per month | Basis |
|---|---|---|
| Cedar Hollow | $20.00 | extra vehicles park in the plowed overflow lot |
| Conestoga Meadows | $20.00 | extra vehicles park in the plowed overflow lot |
| Willow Bend Estates | $12.00 | the rate disclosed in the community prospectus |
| Palmetto Shores | $12.00 | the rate disclosed in the community prospectus |
| every other community | the plan's monthly extra-vehicle permit fee | — |

## Reading the table

- The community is read from the Home-Site Lease of the site whose plan record carries the permits.
- **Cedar Hollow or Conestoga Meadows:** each permit is rated at $20.00 a month.
- **Willow Bend Estates or Palmetto Shores:** each permit is rated at $12.00 a month.
- **A community not named above:** each permit is rated at the plan's monthly extra-vehicle permit fee.

## Hypothetical case

Two residents each carry one permit in the same month, one at Palmetto Shores and one at Cedar Hollow. The permit of the first is rated at $12.00 and that of the second at $20.00, whatever plan each resident holds.
